label: GLM Coding Plan (Zhipu BigModel, Anthropic-compatible)
note: Official Anthropic-compatible endpoint. Set ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN to your BigModel API key. Coding Plan covers glm-5.3 / glm-5.3-flash / glm-5-turbo / glm-4.7; glm-5 and glm-5.1 are auto-routed to glm-5.3 upstream. opus and sonnet route to glm-5.3; haiku and fable route to glm-5.3-flash (added to the plan 2026-08-26 at 3x glm-5.3's quota; natively multimodal, thinking cannot be turned off). CAVEAT: CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS is one client-wide value, not per-slot. It is set to 1000000, which matches every slot the profile ships (glm-5.3 and glm-5.3-flash both take 1M in / 128K out). glm-5-turbo and glm-4.7 only accept 200K, so if you pin one via --model keep that session under 200K. Vision: haiku/fable (glm-5.3-flash) are natively multimodal; glm-5v-turbo (200K) is also reachable with `cl_glm --model glm-5v-turbo`. Docs: https://docs.bigmodel.cn/cn/coding-plan/tool/claude
